modesNote: from 1.0.6 (role variables): the template has a light/dark switch (css/darkmode.css under html[data-theme=dark], the header theme toggle) whose dark side reads the roles too (--dm-* read --ds-c-*), so the Add site popup offers Light | Dark (TDSR MODE-3). Both sides keep the contract's bands: the shared emitter writes a rule both sides share once (side-merge.mjs, 96cc2c0367), so the two-mode module is about 50 KB, under Joomla's 64000 bytes.
modesAutoNote: the pre-paint script in index.php always sets data-theme (light or dark, from the cookie, the locked default, or the OS when the default is auto) before the page paints, so no unmarked 'auto' state is left to the OS: the OS-dark copy is not written (as JA Kinetic Joomla). With it the two-mode module with bands was 75.5 KB, over Joomla's 64000 bytes (lane run 16/10/2026); without it the largest is 40.5 KB over every OpenDesign system and a Refero sample.
templateVarsNote: the template's own T4 theme colours (params/typelist-theme.xml), each in the role the template's palette gives its value; pass-joomla.mjs
bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; visual review 14/10/2026: (1) the footer’s fill (.t4-section.t4-footnav) is a dark band over a dark dot-map picture drawn for that dark ground; as a brand fill whose words it repaints it took any accent, so under a light accent (Moxie, Mailchimp, Linear, Spotify) the map vanished and the white logo sat on yellow or lime: it is an ink band now (the system’s ink on a light page, its surface on a dark one), its words still repainted; (2) the inner page-title band (.ja-masthead, /index.php/our-services) is a pale photo (bg-masthead.png, about #cbd3e0 under its 10% black veil) whose title is the template’s #333: following, the title took a dark system’s light text on the pale photo (invisible under Moxie and Spotify); it is a kept picture band now, its words keep their own dark; (3) the header band was keyed on #t4-header-wrap and painted .t4-section, which is its parent (#t4-header.t4-palette-mainnav paints the white): its ground never landed and the header stayed white under every dark system. It is keyed on #t4-header now, a light panel whose words are repainted (repaint: the level-0 menu links and the toggles take the band’s text, the active and hovered link its accent), so it wears the system’s surface on a dark page and its light one on a light page; the dropdown panels keep their own white with their own words
hoverNote: 21/10/2026 (HOVER-2, TEXT-1 batch 3): menu, title, footer and tag links read one role at rest and on hover under some systems (Moxie, 5fd3), so hover and focus also underline; buttons, dropdown items, the logo and pagination keep their own states. The same underline is written on the link's inner words (span, strong, em, b, small, headings, p): the probe reads the cue on the element that holds the words, and an underline set on the link alone does not change that element's computed style.
